Hi Lorenzo,
I did check your problem and came up with a very "stupid" fix that anyway does the trick. Just add a "\n" to your legend title to put some distance between it and the top legend key. This is the fixed line in your original code:

scale_fill_gradient("GDP % growth\n", low="white", high="red",na.value="grey85",
                      breaks=seq(min(wmap2$value, na.rm=T),max(wmap2$value, na.rm=T) , len=6 )

I tried to tweak other parameters in the legend title, margins, etc. but none seemed to work.

Best Regards,
Marco.
